operations.title: The mod-four conductor carries two mod-two parity grades
operations.body: On D_e6=Z/4, the anti-invariant normalization/conductor complex is [Z/4 --2--> Z/4]. Its kernel and cokernel are each Z/2. The rational contraction by 1/2 does not descend. Because the differential is constant, the same grades persist on s=0, B-1=0, and their corner. This is finite coefficient/Cartier data, not yet physical cohomology; its typed totalization with the separate Gysin simplex remains open.

operations.title: Mod-four conductor cohomology checker
operations.body: Enumeration verifies kernel and image {0,2} modulo four, hence H0=H1=Z/2; modulo two the differential is zero.
